content: The silence of the wise speaks far louder than the clamor of a thousand fools.
author: Chinese Proverbs
explanation: Folly is perpetually noisy, demanding attention, arguing in marketplaces, and shouting to prove its relevance. The sage rests in quiet self-possession. A single glance of calm truth shatters an hour of hysterical posturing.
practicalInsight: Refuse to engage in petty internet or office debates today. Let your dignified silence expose the emptiness of the noise.
reflectionPrompt: Why do you feel compelled to join every argument, when quiet silence would preserve your dignity?
